description: This file defines trip templates data with their structure, including classes like TemplateActivity, TemplateDay, and TripTemplate, as well as functions for retrieving templates by ID. It is frontend-only with no backend dependencies.

classes.name: TemplateActivity
classes.description: Represents an activity in a trip template, with properties like time, title, category, and duration.

classes.name: TemplateDay
classes.description: Defines a day in a trip template, including an index, title, notes, and a list of activities.

classes.name: TripTemplate
classes.description: Defines a complete trip template with an ID, name, description, recommended days, tags, and days.

methods.name: getTemplateById(id)
methods.description: Retrieves a trip template by its ID from the internal list.
